description: Withdraw a return: its status moves to canceled, a final state - no tool moves it back. No stock or money moves. Refused unless the return is requested or approved, and once it carries a refund; a second call is refused the same way. reject_return turns down a requested return instead; complete_return closes a received one. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.
name: cancel_return
title: Cancel return
